name: Intune Remote Help Launcher
description: Intune Remote Help Launcher is a PowerShell WPF tool for IT admins to search Intune-managed devices by name or primary user, view device details, and launch Microsoft Remote Help sessions from one interface. It supports Windows, Android, iOS, and macOS devices, displays OS, compliance, ownership, model and last sync, and can issue sync or restart commands or open the device in the Intune admin center. It uses Microsoft Graph delegated authentication (auto-installs the Graph module if needed) and requires Remote Help licensing to be configured.
author: Mert Efe Kanlikilic
